name: Juli Gumina
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Naperville, Illinois
education: Chicago-Kent College of Law, Illinois Institute of Technology
about: Juli A. Gumina, a respected family law attorney and shareholder at STG Divorce Law, is renowned for her compassionate approach and dedication to resolving complex family law matters. With a practice focusing on high net worth divorces, complex asset divisions, child custody and removal litigation, she brings a deep understanding and a sensitive touch to each case. Her background in handling financial issues related to closely held or family-owned businesses makes her a valuable ally to clients navigating the intricacies of divorce.

Graduating cum laude with a B.A. from Loyola University Chicago, Ms. Gumina was an esteemed member of Alpha Sigma Nu, the national Jesuit honor society. She went on to earn her J.D. from the Illinois Institute of Technology’s Chicago-Kent College of Law, where she distinguished herself by making the dean’s list and joining the Bar and Gavel Society. She honed her skills as a public defender in DuPage County, where she developed a robust foundation in litigation before dedicating her career to family law.

Ms. Gumina is not only a skilled litigator but also a trained mediator, often appointed by courts to mediate family law disputes. Her ability to facilitate collaborative solutions helps clients achieve favorable outcomes while minimizing conflict. Additionally, she serves as a guardian ad litem in both DuPage and Will counties, advocating for children’s best interests in contentious custody cases. Her skills have been recognized with the perfect 10/10 Avvo rating.

An active member of the legal community, Ms. Gumina is a fellow in the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers (AAML), a prestigious organization that includes some of the nation’s top family law practitioners. Her involvement extends to delivering presentations at numerous seminars on various family law topics, helping both legal professionals and the public understand the nuances of divorce and custody issues.

Ms. Gumina’s memberships in the American Bar Association, the Illinois State Bar Association, and the local bar associations in DuPage and Will counties further illustrate her dedication to her field. Through her professional endeavors and commitment to her clients, she continues to make a significant impact in the realm of family law, always with a heart for the individuals and families she serves.
